title: Serhiy Haidai
summary: Serhiy Volodymyrovych Haidai is a Ukrainian entrepreneur and politician who served as the head of the Luhansk Regional Military–Civil Administration during a critical period of the Russian [[full-scale-russo-ukrainian-war|invasion of Ukraine]]. His career includes significant administrative roles in various [[administrative-territorial-entity-of-ukraine|regions of Ukraine]], particularly in Luhansk and [[transcarpathia|Zakarpattia]] Oblasts.

sections.heading: Early Life and Education
paragraphs: Serhiy Haidai was born on 6 November 1975. He pursued his education at the [[khmelnytskyi|Khmelnytskyi]] University of Economics and later graduated from the National Academy for Public Administration under the [[president-of-ukraine|President of Ukraine]].

sections.heading: Political Career
paragraphs: Haidai's political career began with his role as General Director of Dembud LLC from 2005 to 2015. He served as an Assistant Member of the [[kyiv|Kyiv]] City Council from 2008 to 2010 and worked as an Adviser to the Chairman of the Obukhiv Raion State Administration from 2014 to 2015. In 2015, he was elected a Member of the Mukachevo Raion Council and subsequently became Chairman of the Mukachevo Raion State Administration from 2015 to 2018.

sections.heading: Role During the Russian Invasion
paragraphs: During the [[2022-russian-invasion-of-ukraine|2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]], Haidai was appointed as the head of the [[luhansk|Luhansk]] Regional Civil-Military Administration. He provided insights into the tactics employed by Russian forces during the 2022 [[battle-of-sievierodonetsk|Battle of Sievierodonetsk]], noting their strategy of using heavy artillery and air strikes before advancing ground troops.

sections.heading: Dismissal and Subsequent Appointments
paragraphs: Haidai was dismissed from his position on 14 March 2023 by the [[ukrainian|Ukrainian]] Cabinet of Ministers, with the official decree enacted on 15 March 2023. He was later appointed as the Head of the State Administration of the Mukachevo District in [[zakarpattia-oblast|Zakarpattia Oblast]] on 15 March 2024.

sections.heading: Legal Issues
paragraphs: In August 2025, Haidai faced legal troubles when he was arrested on charges related to a corruption scandal involving inflated state contracts for drones and electronic warfare equipment during his tenure in Mukachevo. He was dismissed from his position on 2 August 2025 by [[volodymyr-zelenskyy|President Zelenskyy]] in connection with these charges.
